scientific_integrity: Finite checks were performed but do not establish the infinite-dimensional asymptotics, which have analytic proofs. Historical-priority searches were bounded and cannot establish absolute uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The exact induced Gini norm is established only in dimensions one through three; in larger dimensions the exact critical-window full norm and precise norming cuts are not determined. The single-site Gaussian profile is a lower-bound witness, not a full-norm identity. The known earlier 1988/1990 hypercube-mixing literature uses another kernel and metric; first daily availability of that earlier text was not verified.
title: Three-bit onset and Gaussian cutoff for Gini contraction under Boolean noise
